# Cedric Stanhope & Nora

- [Cedric Stanhope](../character/cedric-stanhope.md) — Friend of — [Nora](../character/nora.md) — imaginary rock person companion · since v2  <sub>[v2 XI Facts and Fancies P42](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0042)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> A letter from [Cedric Stanhope](../character/cedric-stanhope.md) details his imaginary, whimsical companions near the shore, including [Nora](../character/nora.md), the [Golden Lady](../character/golden-lady.md), and the [Twin Sailors](../codex/places.md#twin-sailors). He describes fantastic adventures with them, such as sailing into the moon and traveling into the sunset.
>
> — v2 · XI Facts and Fancies
